title: The Clever Rabbit
text:
Once there was a small rabbit. He lived in a green field near a big tree. Every morning, he ate fresh grass.

One day, a hungry wolf saw the rabbit. The rabbit was not afraid. He said, 'Look at the river! There is a big fish in the water.' The wolf ran to the river to catch the fish. The rabbit ran home fast.

options: In a green field near a big tree

questions.text: Why did the wolf run to the river?
options: He believed the rabbit about the fish
He wanted to go swimming with the rabbit
He was looking for the big tree
He wanted to meet a friend

questions.text: What kind of character is the rabbit?

vocabulary.definition: a small animal with long ears
a long stream of water that flows to the sea

paragraph_translations: Bir zamanlar küçük bir tavşan varmış. Büyük bir ağacın yanındaki yeşil bir tarlada yaşarmış. Her sabah taze ot yermiş.
Bir gün, aç bir kurt tavşanı görmüş. Tavşan korkmamış. Demiş ki: 'Nehre bak! Suyun içinde büyük bir balık var.' Kurt balığı yakalamak için nehre koşmuş. Tavşan hızla eve koşmuş.
